title: AI boom lifts Foxconn August sales to USD 29.14 billion
description: Foxconn's August sales surged significantly, reaching the second-highest monthly total in its history. This growth was fueled by strong demand for artificial intelligence applications and consumer electronics. Meanwhile, Apple supplier Largan Precision experienced a year-on-year sales decrease in August. Largan anticipates improved sales in September due to peak season demand. Both companies are preparing for new product launches and inventory rebuilding.
